nodes.label: Book/Booklet/Photobook Product Type
nodes.description: productType: 'book' — a third product type for multi-page bound products (photobook, booklet, brochure). Customer-variable page count, two authored templates (cover + inner page), server-side materializer expands them at render time.

nodes.label: book_layout.py Materializer
nodes.description: services/book_layout.py::materialize_pages() — expands a book template into concrete per-page surface dicts. Mirrors calendar_layout.py::materialize_surfaces() architecture. Also includes gutter_side_for, gutter_shift_fraction, pages_to_spreads, apply_gutter.

nodes.label: book-layout.ts Frontend Twin
nodes.description: frontend/nextjs/src/lib/book-layout.ts — TypeScript parity twin of book_layout.py. Contains resolvePageGeometry, spineWidthMm, pagesToSpreads, planFrameSlots, allocateFilesToSurfaces.

nodes.label: validate_book_layout
nodes.description: api/validators.py::validate_book_layout — validates book layout schema: positive width/height on cover and innerPage canvas, pageCount range, bleedMm, gutterMm, paperThicknessMm.

nodes.label: _extract_book_state
nodes.description: api/tasks.py::_extract_book_state — extracts page count and per-page overrides from editor_state alongside the calendar equivalent.

nodes.label: Surface Allocation
nodes.description: frontend surface-allocation.ts::allocateFilesToSurfaces / planFrameSlots — allocates uploaded photos across surfaces, supporting multi-frame (collage) pages. Fixed prerequisite for book builds.

nodes.label: Customer-Variable Page Count
nodes.description: First product type where surface count is customer state. Template declares pageCount: {min, max, step, default}; customer types a count, inner pages auto-populate from the single inner-page template. Steps in multiples of 4 (signature folding).

nodes.label: Gutter / Spine Margin
nodes.description: book.gutterMm — inner margin auto-mirrored by page parity (odd pages bind left, even bind right). Shift is half the gutter figure applied uniformly across a page's frames/overlays, capped by tightest element's headroom.

nodes.label: Spine Width Formula
nodes.description: spineWidthMm = (pageCount/2 leaves) × paperThicknessMm — computed dimension recomputed whenever customer changes page count. Implementation differs from PRD sketch (which double-counted) — needs Catalog Ops sign-off.

nodes.label: pagesToSpreads
nodes.description: services/book_layout.py::pages_to_spreads() and lib/book-layout.ts::pagesToSpreads() — groups flat page list into spread pairs for read-only preview. Page 1 alone, then facing pairs, last alone, covers always alone.

nodes.label: API Surface Separation PRD
nodes.description: Plan to separate Direct Partner API and Iframe Embed API into explicit public surfaces, routing all through one shared render submission service. Status: OPEN, not started.

nodes.label: Shared Render Submission Service
nodes.description: Proposed api/services/render_submission.py — consolidates CanvasData upsert, RenderJob creation, queue selection, and Celery dispatch currently duplicated between GenerateLayoutView and EditorRenderView.

nodes.label: Access-Mode Invariant
nodes.description: Core policy: dashboard and embed access must produce byte-equivalent print outputs for the same inputs. Authentication and delivery differ by mode, but rendering behavior must not. Restated in CLAUDE.md as 'access-mode invariant'.

nodes.label: GenerateLayoutView Sync Dead Code
nodes.description: GenerateLayoutView._handle_sync() at views.py:566 — unreachable synchronous helper still present. post() routes only to async. Removal planned in Phase 2 of API Surface Separation.

nodes.label: Data Lifecycle & Retention
nodes.description: Documents all customer data the Product Editor stores, retention periods, and deletion mechanisms. Single EXPORT_RETENTION_DAYS clock (default 7, prod currently 3) governs uploads, exports, and canvas data.

nodes.label: EXPORT_RETENTION_DAYS
nodes.description: Single env var governing retention of uploads, exports, and canvas data. All four GC sweeps run off this value. Previously disagreed (14-day files vs 30-day expires_at promise) — fixed in migration 0012.

nodes.label: Order Data Purge (DPDP Erasure)
nodes.description: DELETE /api/ops/orders/<order_id>/purge — ops-only hard-delete of all customer data for an order_id. Returns erasure_complete + unlocated_upload_rows. Scoped to all API keys unless narrowed with ?api_key=.

nodes.label: DPDP Erasure Gap (CLOSED)
nodes.description: PRD documenting closed erasure bug: purge reported success while photos remained on disk. Root cause: autosave blanked CanvasData.image_paths every 2s. Fixed in migration 0011 with UploadedFile.order_id linkage and directory-based purge.

nodes.label: UploadedFile.order_id
nodes.description: order_id field added to UploadedFile in migration 0011. Populated from X-Order-ID header at upload. Makes erasure provable without depending on canvas state. Direct partner API uploads record blank order_id.

nodes.label: Order-Scoped Upload Paths
nodes.description: Uploads stored under UPLOADS_DIR/<order_id>/ — ownership visible in path. Purge deletes the directory outright, finding files even without a DB row. Dot-leading and dot-only order_ids rejected to prevent path traversal.

nodes.label: Orphan Exports Sweep
nodes.description: services/orphan_exports.py — sweeps EXPORTS_DIR for directories with no DB row. Gated by GC_ORPHAN_SWEEP env (off/dry_run/delete; defaults to dry_run — reports only, deletes nothing in production).

nodes.label: API Audit Trail
nodes.description: APIRequest rows logging ip_address and user_agent per non-exempt API call. Retention: API_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS (default 90). Fixed in migration 0014 — previously model existed but nothing wrote to it.

nodes.label: Monitoring Stack (Grafana/Loki/Promtail)
